test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Under the 'Talent Search and Development' component of 'Khelo India' programme to carry out talent identification, the country has been divided into how many zones as of July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Five'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To carry out talent identification, the country has been divided into **five zones.**
 
• The five zones are namely,** North, East, West, South, and North-East Zones.**
